title: Good and Bad
text:
Good and Bad. Seller has contacted me many times offering me Amazon gift cards, starting at $15, now up to $30, to remove my review. She even claims she will lose her job if I don't. I won't adjust my review, because it's my word. Pillows are lumpy, but I do use it with another pillow when I need to raise my head. It was never flat, and does hold my head, just not high enough.

I opened them, and let them sit and rise, one at a time so I could compare how much it's left up. One is actually flatter than the other. It's relatively comfortable, but it's not quite high enough for me, and two of them is too high. Also, if I try to reshape it a bit, it gets all cattywampus. Overall, I like that they are dense, but not hard like any memory pillow I have tried, I just wish I could get a little more height to it.
